milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The blast furnace is placed at spawn-relative [0, 0, 8] (8 blocks forward from spawn). With max_distance=5, the player must walk at least 3 blocks forward toward the workshop to be within range. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the blast furnace, confirming visual identification rather than just passing nearby.
